experiment: Fixed GU-AGQ (AGQ gate/up + GPTQ down) across 4 MoE layers and 3 matched C4 Random seeds
nature: retrospective robustness / mechanism study; GU-AGQ was motivated by L8/L16 seed-0 results and both evaluation splits were inspected before; previously inspected cells: [(0, 8), (0, 16)]

methods.fixed_rule: GU_AGQ for every expert, layer and seed; no selection of any kind
methods.source: the two candidate sets of the SAME seed only

primary.note: document-disjoint confirmation split; identical windows to runs_legacy_metric_reeval; inspected in earlier studies -> not pristine

secondary.note: historical test rows 2128-2255; inspected in many prior studies

metric: E_L = sum ||y_BF16 - y_q||^2 / (sum ||y_BF16||^2 + 1e-30) (AGQ-only validation definition: fp32 complete expert outputs, float64 sums, frozen BF16 routing fp32 softmax top-4 c without renorm, shared expert included)
aggregate: E_4L = mean of the four per-layer ratios (pooled ratio reported as secondary diagnostic only)

comparisons.primary: Delta_s = (E4L_GU - E4L_FULL_AGQ) / E4L_FULL_AGQ per seed; mean over seeds

decision_rule.BLOCKED: any artifact / regression / correctness check fails
decision_rule.PROMISING: all: (1) mean_s Delta_s <= -tau (confirm); (2) Delta_s < 0 for all 3 seeds; (3) for each layer, seed-averaged E_L(GU) vs seed-averaged E_L(FULL_AGQ) <= +0.5 %; (4) old-test mean_s Delta_s < 0; (5) correctness; (6) estimated fresh-deployment cost of a direct GU-AGQ pass <= 1.10x Full AGQ
decision_rule.UNSTABLE: not promising and either (per-seed Delta_s signs differ and max_s Delta_s - min_s Delta_s >= tau) or (old-test mean Delta has the opposite sign to confirm mean Delta and |old-test mean Delta| >= tau)
decision_rule.SMALL_GAIN: not above; Delta_s < 0 for all seeds, old-test mean Delta < 0, mean Delta > -tau
decision_rule.LAYER_SPECIFIC: not above; some layer's seed-averaged GU vs FULL_AGQ <= -tau and another's >= +tau
decision_rule.NO_GAIN: otherwise (GU-AGQ equal to or worse than Full AGQ, or no consistent improvement)

diagnostics: DOWN_AGQ for exact 2-group Shapley attribution (not a candidate)
conditional: direct single-pass GU-AGQ path implemented and timed ONLY if PROMISING
